title: Tabulation preamble gates
statement: Let $\kappa$ be finite, let $m,w,n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $F:\kappa\to\mathrm{List}(\mathrm{Bool})\to\mathrm{List}(\mathrm{Bool})$, let $z$ be a Boolean list, and let $W\in\mathbb{N}$. The preamble consists, in order, of a false-constant gate, a true-constant gate, one constant gate for each bit of $z$, and $W$ false-constant gates.
